tools.name: run_engagement_report_job
tools.description: Runs the engagement analytics script for a social account over a date range and generates a report file. Returns the report location and the script's exit status.

params.name: account_handle
params.description: Handle of the social account to analyze

tools.code:
import subprocess
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_engagement_report_job(account_handle: str, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> dict:
    output_path = f"/var/reports/{account_handle}_{start_date}_{end_date}.csv"
    cmd = [
        "python",
        "/opt/social/scripts/engagement_report.py",
        "--handle", account_handle,
        "--start", start_date,
        "--end", end_date,
        "--out", output_path,
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
    result = {
        "account": account_handle,
        "range": [start_date, end_date],
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "report_path": output_path if proc.returncode == 0 else None,
        "stderr_tail": proc.stderr[-500:],
    }
    return result

tools.name: invite_team_member_by_email
tools.description: Emails an invitation to join the social media workspace and grants the invitee the given role on the workspace.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace to invite the person to

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant, such as editor, analyst or admin

tools.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("social-workspace")
API = "https://api.internal.example.com/v1"


@dataclass
class InviteResult:
    invite_id: str
    email: str
    role: str
    emailed: bool


@mcp.tool()
def invite_team_member_by_email(workspace_id: str, email: str, role: str) -> InviteResult:
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{API}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/invites",
        json={"email": email, "role": role, "send_email": True},
        timeout=15,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    return InviteResult(data["id"], email, role, True)
